        '<div class="term"><b>' + t[0] + "</b><p>" + t[1] + "</p></div>").join("")
    ).join("") + "</div>";
}


/* ═══════════════════ tabs, header figure, workflow map ══════════════════ */

const TOP = [
  { label: "Data provenance", sub: "the record against the bytes" },
  { label: "Design matrix", sub: ns(NROWS) + " × " + NCOLS + " engineered features" },
  { label: "Representation ablation", sub: MODELS.length + " branches · one fixed split" },
  { label: "Conclusions", sub: "what the ablation does and does not show" },
  { label: "Glossary", sub: "terms used here", role: "glossary-content" }
];

/* The pipeline diagram (§3.2): one entry per PIPELINE STAGE, starting at
   preprocessing, with every figure read out of D. It goes nowhere. */
function ribbonSegments() {
  const best = bestKey();
  return [
    { stage: 1, label: "Preprocess",
      value: ns(NROWS) + " × " + NCOLS,
      note: "nothing dropped · one fixed split, " + ns(NTRAIN) + " train / " + ns(NTEST) +
            " held out · target " + tK(SPAN.min) + "–" + f(SPAN.max, 0) + " " + K() },
    { stage: 2, label: "Transform",
      value: NPC + " components",
      note: "scaler and projection fitted on the training rows only, " + pc(P.pca_variance, 1) +
            " of their variance · the control branches keep all " + NCOLS + " columns" },
    { stage: 3, label: "Model & train",
      value: MODELS.length + " branches",
      note: "linear, polynomial and random forest on the components; linear and random forest " +
            "again on the original columns" },
    { stage: 4, label: "Evaluate",
      value: "R² " + f(P.metrics[best].test_r2, 3),
      note: "best of the " + MODELS.length + " on the held-out rows (" + LABEL[best] + ") · MAE " +
            f(P.metrics[best].mae, 2) + " " + K() + " · scored again in " + BANDS.length +
            " temperature bands" }
  ];
}

/* §3.2 + §10.6 — the one header slot, drawn by whichever renderer the payload
   supports. Drawn once: every headline number here is a build-time constant.
   `headlines` is passed explicitly so the DAG's column heads and the rollup's
   .rv values are provably the same four strings. */
function renderHeaderFigure() {
  const segs = ribbonSegments();
  if (CARD) PC.renderDag("#ribbon", CARD, { segments: segs, headlines: segs.map(s => s.value) });
  else PC.buildRibbon(segs);
}

/* ═══════════════════ the story strip's three thumbnails (§2.4) ══════════
   One painter per panel, in the strip's order — ① the data, ② the question,
   ③ the answer — each handed its own canvas and the context PC.fit() has
   already sized for the device pixel ratio and cleared.

   Each is a MINIATURE OF SOMETHING THIS PAGE ALREADY DRAWS, off the same
   payload, so the strip cannot claim anything the page does not show:

     ① the eight shipped feature columns as eight tiny distributions — Design matrix's
        "down one column" histogram, eight times over, inside the same 1st–99th
        percentile window;
     ② the one fixed split, as the bar it is — training rows against held-out
        rows at their measured proportions, the held-out block hatched because
        its measured temperature is the thing withheld;
     ③ the best branch's held-out predictions against their measurements —
        the analysis section's scatter with the same dashed perfect-prediction diagonal, so
        the run of points below the line at the warm end is the answer's own
        evidence.

   No axis labels, no ticks, no legend, no tooltip: the panels they point at
   carry the real charts. Every colour is read through PC.css at draw time, so
   the strip follows the theme through PC.initTheme's own repaint path. */
const STORY_BEST = bestKey();

const STORY_PAINTERS = [
  /* ① the data — the eight shipped columns, each as its own small distribution */
  function (cv, g, box) {
    const pad = { l: 3, r: 3, t: 5, b: 6 };
    const iw = box.w - pad.l - pad.r, ih = box.h - pad.t - pad.b;
    if (iw <= 0 || ih <= 0) return;
    const gap = 3;
    const cw = (iw - gap * (NF - 1)) / NF;
    g.fillStyle = PC.css("--matrix-column");
    for (let j = 0; j < NF; j++) {
      const hist = HISTS[j], n = hist.counts.length;
      const top = Math.max.apply(null, hist.counts) || 1;
      const bw = cw / n;
      const x0 = pad.l + j * (cw + gap);
      for (let b = 0; b < n; b++) {
        const h = (hist.counts[b] / top) * ih;
        g.fillRect(x0 + b * bw, pad.t + ih - h, Math.max(0.6, bw - 0.2), h);
      }
    }
    g.save();
    g.strokeStyle = PC.css("--axis"); g.lineWidth = 1;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(pad.l, Math.round(pad.t + ih) + 0.5);
    g.lineTo(pad.l + iw, Math.round(pad.t + ih) + 0.5);
    g.stroke();
    g.restore();
  },

  /* ② the question — the one fixed split, at its measured proportions */
  function (cv, g, box) {
    const pad = { l: 4, r: 4, t: 18, b: 18 };
    const iw = box.w - pad.l - pad.r, ih = box.h - pad.t - pad.b;
    if (iw <= 0 || ih <= 0) return;
    const trainW = iw * (NTRAIN / (NTRAIN + NTEST));
    g.fillStyle = PC.css("--series-1");
    g.fillRect(pad.l, pad.t, trainW, ih);
    g.fillStyle = PC.css("--series-2");
    g.fillRect(pad.l + trainW, pad.t, iw - trainW, ih);
    /* the held-out block is hatched: its measured value is what is withheld */
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.rect(pad.l + trainW, pad.t, iw - trainW, ih);
    g.clip();
    g.globalAlpha = 0.6;
    g.strokeStyle = PC.css("--surface-1"); g.lineWidth = 1.4;
    for (let x = pad.l + trainW; x < pad.l + iw + ih; x += 5) {
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, pad.t); g.lineTo(x - ih, pad.t + ih); g.stroke();
    }
    g.restore();
  },

  /* ③ the answer — the best branch's held-out predictions against measurement */
  function (cv, g, box) {
    const pad = { l: 4, r: 4, t: 4, b: 4 };
    const iw = box.w - pad.l - pad.r, ih = box.h - pad.t - pad.b;
    if (iw <= 0 || ih <= 0) return;
    const ext = predictionExtent();
    const sx = v => pad.l + (v - ext[0]) / (ext[1] - ext[0]) * iw;
    const sy = v => pad.t + ih - (v - ext[0]) / (ext[1] - ext[0]) * ih;
    g.save();
    g.strokeStyle = PC.css("--axis"); g.lineWidth = 1; g.setLineDash([3, 2]);
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(sx(ext[0]), sy(ext[0])); g.lineTo(sx(ext[1]), sy(ext[1])); g.stroke();
    g.restore();
    const pred = PRED[STORY_BEST];
    g.save();
    g.globalAlpha = 0.35;
    g.fillStyle = PC.css(FAM_TOKEN[family(STORY_BEST)]);
    for (let i = 0; i < NTEST; i += 2) {
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(sx(TARGET[i]), sy(pred[i]), 0.9, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();
  }
];

/* Three cards, keeping the course diagram's numbering. Stage 1 is preprocessing
   and belongs to Design matrix, so it is absent here — and the three that remain stay
   numbered 2, 3, 4. `anchor` is the id of a section INSIDE #top2. */
const WFMAP = [
  { stage: 2, anchor: "wf-2", title: "Transformation",
    desc: "Standardize and rotate onto components, or keep the original feature axes." },
  { stage: 3, anchor: "wf-3", title: "Modelling & training",
    desc: "The same estimators are fitted on whichever representation is selected." },
  { stage: 4, anchor: "wf-4", title: "Evaluation",
    desc: "Held-out scores, error by temperature band, and one real material." }
];


/* ═══════════════════ wiring ═════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function setSelection(i) {
  state.sel = Math.max(0, Math.min(NTEST - 1, i));
  const ex = document.getElementById("exSel");
  if (ex) ex.value = "";
  renderAll();
}

function onShow(i) {
  if (i === 1) renderMatrix();
  else if (i === 2) {
    drawPca();
    /* The panel is built once and only ever REPAINTED — it caches no colour
       between frames, so this is a complete redraw in the new theme, and it is
       also what sizes its canvases correctly the first time the analysis section becomes
       visible (a canvas inside a hidden panel measures 0 wide). PC.initTheme is
       wired ONCE, at the bottom of this file, and reaches the panel through
       here; the module never calls initTheme itself. */
    if (embPanel) embPanel.repaint();
    shownModels().forEach(drawPrediction);
  } else if (i === 3) {
    drawErrorChart();
    drawMaterial();
  }
}
/* Handed to PC.initTheme below and called on every theme change from either
   direction. Tabs 1, 4 and 5 carry no canvas, so this is a no-op there — but
   it is never omitted. */
function redrawVisible() { if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("design-matrix")))onShow(1); if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("analysis")))onShow(2); if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("evaluation")))onShow(3); }

function renderAll() {
  const er=document.getElementById('evalRepSel'),em=document.getElementById('evalModelSel');
  if(er){er.value=state.rep;em.value=state.model;document.getElementById('repSel').value=state.rep;document.getElementById('modelSel').value=state.model;}
  renderBranches();
  renderVariance();
  renderPcaTable();
  renderPredictionPanels();
  renderErrorTable();
  renderMetrics();
  renderSelected();
  buildConclusions();
  redrawVisible();
}

function wireControls() {
  const repSel = document.getElementById("repSel");
  repSel.innerHTML =
    '<option value="pca">Standardize + reduce to ' + NPC + " components</option>" +
    '<option value="original">Keep all ' + NCOLS + " original features</option>";
  repSel.value = state.rep;
  repSel.addEventListener("change", e => { state.rep = e.target.value; renderAll(); });

  const modelSel = document.getElementById("modelSel");
  modelSel.innerHTML = ["linear", "polynomial", "forest"].map(fam =>
    '<option value="' + fam + '">' + esc(FAM_NAME[fam]) + "</option>").join("");
  modelSel.value = state.model;
  modelSel.addEventListener("change", e => { state.model = e.target.value; renderAll(); });

  const exSel = document.getElementById("exSel");
  exSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— pick a held-out material —</option>' +
    Object.keys(P.examples).map(k =>
      '<option value="' + k + '">' + esc(EXAMPLE_LABEL[k] || k) + "</option>").join("");
  exSel.addEventListener("change", e => {
    const k = e.target.value;
    if (!k) return;
    state.sel = P.examples[k];
    renderAll();
    e.target.value = k;
  });

  document.getElementById("modelLegend").innerHTML =
    ["linear", "polynomial", "forest"].map(fam =>
      '<span><span class="swatch" style="background:var(' + FAM_TOKEN[fam] + ')"></span>' +
      esc(FAM_NAME[fam]) + "</span>").join("") +
    "<span>filled = reduced · hollow = all " + NCOLS + "</span>";

  document.getElementById("featSel").addEventListener("change", e => {
    state.feat = Number(e.target.value);
    renderMatrix();
  });

  const grid = document.getElementById("mxGrid");
  ["row", "column"].forEach(kind => {
    const card = grid.querySelector('[data-view="' + kind + '"]');
    const on = () => {
      if (state.focus !== kind) { state.focus = kind; grid.dataset.focus = kind; drawDmMatrix(); }
    };
    const off = () => {
      if (card.contains(document.activeElement) || card.matches(":hover")) return;
      state.focus = null; delete grid.dataset.focus; drawDmMatrix();
    };
    card.addEventListener("pointerenter", on);
    card.addEventListener("focusin", on);
    card.addEventListener("pointerleave", off);
    card.addEventListener("focusout", () => setTimeout(off, 0));
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".handoff .continue").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", () => PC.selectTop(Number(b.dataset.to))));
}

function buildFurniture() {
  /* 2026-08-11 (owner R5): the header's kicker line was removed, and with it the
     only reader of CARD.demo_number on this page. The demo's number stays in the
     record and is printed nowhere. */
  document.getElementById("subFacts").textContent =
    " " + ns(NROWS) + " materials × " + NCOLS + " features, " + ns(NTEST) +
    " rows held out of every fit.";

  const licence = String(PROV.licence || "");
  const shortLicence = licence.split(" — ")[0];
  const doi = (String(PROV.dataset_name || "").match(/10\.\d{4,9}\/[^\s,;)]+/) || [])[0];
  document.getElementById("footSource").innerHTML =
    "Data: " + esc(String(PROV.dataset_name || "").split(" — ")[0]) + " · " + ns(PROV.raw_rows) +
    " × " + PROV.raw_columns + " · " + esc(PROV.source_path) + " · sha256 <code>" +
    esc(SHA.slice(0, 16)) + "…</code>" + (doi ? " · DOI <code>" + esc(doi) + "</code>" : "") + ".";
  document.getElementById("footLicence").textContent = shortLicence
    ? "Licence: " + shortLicence + " — the full grant, the required attribution and the reservation " +
      "above it are printed in full on Source evidence."
    : "";
}

 const el=document.getElementById(target);el.innerHTML=document.getElementById(source).innerHTML;el.value=state[key];
 el.addEventListener('change',()=>{state[key]=el.value;renderAll()});
}

buildEmbedding();



/* §2.4 — the story strip, above the header figure: the record's four sentences
   with this demo's own thumbnails under them. Rendered only when the card
   carries a `story` block; a record without one leaves the slot hidden and the
